style: Precision counter-striker & range-control kickboxer in a woven slate-indigo and bronze-gold combat uniform
claims: Rigged to the standard Mixamo mixamorig: 65-bone skeleton with all 28 required combat animation clips within +/-10% of the reference durations

Upgrades the Diffuse maps (Ch48_1001_Diffuse and Ch48_1002_Diffuse) to 4096x4096 px and the Normal, Specular, and Emissive maps to 2048x2048 px extracted from assets/mixamo/roster/gemini.fbx while preserving Blender's packed glTF metallicRoughness maps

Reconstructs photorealistic chestnut-brown human irises, deep black pupils, dark limbal rings, and vascularized sclera on the exact eyeball UV islands (Comp 6 & 7) in Ch48_1001_Diffuse, warms the 4K facial skin complexion, removes neon-cyan eyeliner into natural lash pigment, and grades the hair (Ch48_1003_Diffuse) to natural dark espresso-brown strands

Transforms both the upper-torso/sleeve UV islands (Ch48_1001_Diffuse) and lower-body UV islands (Ch48_1002_Diffuse) into a cohesive dark charcoal-slate and Gemini indigo ripstop-weave combat uniform with bronze-gold accents
Configures physically based glTF materials using KHR_materials_specular, KHR_materials_sheen, KHR_materials_clearcoat, and KHR_materials_ior (1.42) with metallicFactor set to 0.0 on skin and hair
Includes a custom combat sound effects suite in sfx/ combining 11 curated CC0 Kenney OGG impacts/whooshes with 8 studio-mastered multi-layered 44.1 kHz WAV strike and K.O. bell audio files
All four 1920x1080 beauty renders (front, three_quarter, profile, closeup) are rendered directly from the submitted fighter.glb posed in fighting_idle
